note: Healthy structured Chinese output that actually reaches character mode: the keys are Chinese too, so the only letters in the response are CJK and the non-spaced ratio is 1.000. (Its sibling json-zh-array-valid has ASCII keys, measures 0.378, and dispatches to word mode -- so it cannot demonstrate anything about char-mode behaviour, which is what this fixture is for.) Under char n-grams (n=4) twenty distinct items score 0.543, and the curve flattens rather than climbing: 0.396 at eight items, 0.474 at twelve, 0.577 at thirty, 0.597 at forty. It converges because each item carries a constant amount of scaffolding, so the duplicate fraction tends toward the scaffolding proportion instead of diverging. That plateau near 0.6 against the weakest pure CJK loop at 0.872 leaves a margin of roughly 0.19 -- under this package's 0.2 bar, and sensitive to how many keys a payload carries. Char TAIL_LOOP scores 0.000 here because scaffolding never repeats with an exact period, which is why that detector shipped and char-mode REPETITION did not.
